name: crm-sre-team
description: Offline CRM evidence analysis. Real WorkBuddy native delegation when available; otherwise single-model analysis. A separate managed Harness remains unimplemented.

displayDescription.en: Authorized evidence only. Real native delegation when available; otherwise single-model analysis. No production access or fabricated consultation.
displayDescription.zh: 仅分析授权脱敏材料，按真实能力协同七域专家或单模型分析；不连接生产、不伪造会诊，结论供人工复核。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 仅分析我指定且允许分享的脱敏材料，不连接生产、不索取凭据。生产写操作只给人工评审卡；只读查询命令可提供并说明范围，用户指定的公开读取在宿主允许时直接执行，生产只读通道未配置时写明未执行。有真实 WorkBuddy 团队能力时按需委派成员，否则明确单模型分析、不模拟会诊。验证失败的托管任务不可降级绕过。用户每轮最多3项原子请求。我的问题与已有材料如下：
defaultInitPrompt.en: Analyze only my authorized sanitized materials. No production access or credentials. Production writes get a human review card only; read-only query commands may be provided with scope, public reads the user names are executed when the host permits, and unimplemented production read channels are stated as not executed. Delegate only using actual permitted WorkBuddy team tools; otherwise state single-model analysis. Do not bypass failed managed verification. At most 3 atomic user requests per round. quickPrompts.zh: 变更后订单积压与接口超时。请先核对我提供的变更摘要、时窗和证据，按证据选择必要专家；回退只能给人工评审卡，时间重合不等于根因。
quickPrompts.en: Review my change summary, event window and evidence for order backlog and interface timeouts. Route only as justified; rollback is a human review card, not presumed cause or execution.

quickPrompts.zh: CRM性能逐渐劣化。先利用已有业务指标和材料，再按证据决定需要哪个专业域；不要默认同时索取Oracle、JVM和主机快照，每轮最多3项原子材料。
quickPrompts.en: CRM performance is degrading. Start with existing business metrics and evidence, then select relevant domains. Do not default to Oracle, JVM and host snapshots; at most 3 atomic requests per round.
